resources.string: Lets the AI agents on your PC (Claude Code and others) message you, ask you things and propose tasks, and lets you chat with them. Runs on your PC over Tailscale: see tools/lumi-hub.
Use the https address the hub printed (your Tailscale name).
Can\'t reach the hub (%1$s). Is it running, and is Tailscale on in both devices?
The hub refused this phone: check the token and that Tailscale uses your own account.
Live: messages from your agents arrive while Lumi is open
Messages from agents are shown as text only. Lumi never runs anything they send, and a task they propose is added only if you tap Add task.
Messages, questions and task proposals from the AI agents on your PC (Lumi Hub)
